en.p: For a positive number $k$, there is a function $f(x)=\tan\dfrac{x}{k}$ defined on the set $\left\{x\ \middle|\ 0\le x<\dfrac{3k\pi}{2},\ x\ne\dfrac{k\pi}{2}\right\}$. Let $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ $\left(\overline{\mathrm{PA}}<\overline{\mathrm{PB}}\right)$ be the two points where the line through $\mathrm{P}(0,\,p)\ (p>0)$ parallel to the $x$-axis meets the graph of $y=f(x)$, and let $\mathrm{C}$ be the point where the line $y=-p$ meets the graph of $y=f(x)$.
When $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=3\overline{\mathrm{PA}}$ and the area of triangle $\mathrm{OCB}$ is $\dfrac{5\pi}{3}$, what is the value of $k+p$? (Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin.) [4 points]
